study: "Reward quotes live-prep" (2026-10-04): Phase A, the search for the best Polymarket reward strategy on everything known (Davies: "以现在知道的所有信息，选出来一个最佳的reward区间+市场+rules等一切最优的策略，不考虑其他一切因素…"), RW's stored record (2026-09-25 00:00 -> 10-04 15:12 UTC) replayed at the live account's size with RW's own functions and an account's caps, sells, stops and carried positions, 15 rounds and about 290 arms, every one reported; a keyless read of the whole rate >= $10 universe and its tracking every 30 minutes; and Phase B's checks: the pre-registration's day-1 check and live readout, and the go-time statement and the one-armed trigger on PGlite
write_up: docs/agents/reviews/2026-10-04-polymarket-lp-prereg.md (the specification S2, its evidence table and its conditions); reference §4 item 54

inputs.data/min_YYYY-MM-DD.json.gz: RW's stored minutes per day (pm_rw_minutes: each market's recorded book row and RW's decision), read through the Supabase connector, read-only, 2026-10-04; scripts/grab.py extracted each from the connector's saved reply
inputs.data/small.json.gz: RW's selections, the markets' metadata and every stored print of the run (pm_rw_selection, pm_rw_prints), read-only, 2026-10-04
inputs.data/small_1444.json.gz: the same, re-read at 14:44 UTC for the record's last hours
inputs.data/mini.json.gz, data/mid.json.gz: mini-pool's and mid-pool's own dry-run records (pm_prep_*, pm_midprep_*), read-only, for their per-dollar figures
inputs.data/pools_1454.json.gz: every market of RW's universe with its pool's other makers as RW recorded them, re-read at 14:54 UTC (scripts/grabpool.py)
inputs.data/universe_1.json.gz: a keyless read of the whole reward listing and every book of it, 2026-10-04 15:21 UTC (scripts/universe.ts)
inputs.data/track_K.json.gz: the same universe's books read again every 30 minutes, 15:37 -> 17:07 UTC (scripts/universe_track.ts; four reads, the job stopped by its time limit before the fifth)

run: cd docs/agents/backtests/pmlp && gunzip -k data/*.gz  # the scripts read data/*.json, relative to this folder

npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --no-check scripts/roundN.ts > results/roundN.txt  # N = 1..15; each writes results/roundN.json as well (committed gzipped); scripts/sim.ts is the simulator, scripts/rec.ts the loaders, scripts/exp.ts the arms' runner and its day-block bootstrap (mulberry32 seed 20261004, 2,000 draws)

npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --no-check scripts/check_sim.ts  # the simulator reproduces RW's pm_rw_days at RW's own settings, to the cent; scripts/check_x1.ts the same for RW-X's x1
npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --no-check scripts/pools_sim.ts > results/pools_sim.txt; scripts/pools_s2.ts > results/pools_s2.txt  # the bands' and the pools' per-dollar figures

npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --no-check scripts/s1_bars.ts > results/s1_bars.txt  # S1's bars; scripts/s1_shares.ts, s1_slots.ts, s2_shares.ts, permarket.ts, band_records.ts, decay.ts, decay_cause.ts, intraday.ts, hazard.ts, ranges.ts: the further readings the write-up quotes
python3 scripts/uni_bands.py > results/uni_bands.txt; python3 scripts/track_an.py > results/track_an.txt  # the universe's bands at 15:21 UTC, and the top ten's decay across the four tracked reads
npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-net --allow-write scripts/universe.ts data/universe.json  # live, keyless: a new read of the universe (the committed one is universe_1)

lp_check.sql  # the pre-registration's day-1 check: read-only, one statement, run once at or after d1 + 1 day 00:10 UTC; its sha256 is pinned by src/pm_lp_prereg.test.js and named in the pre-registration
lp_readout.sql  # the live readout (R, the 7-day end rule's reading, the fills per share): read-only, one statement; pinned the same way

npm i --prefix /tmp/pglite @electric-sql/pglite@0.2.17 && PGLITE=/tmp/pglite/node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/index.js node docs/agents/backtests/pmlp/scripts/lp_live_check.mjs  # from the repository root: every migration on PGlite, the design doc's step 8lp word for word on each refusal and five balances, the one-armed trigger on three configs; -> results/lp_live_check_out.txt; `nokey` or `widen` as an argument: its counterfactuals, each failing two checks
reproduced: round 15 re-run from these gzipped inputs on 2026-10-04 gave results/round15.txt's rows, digit for digit
